items.note: A teal identity band carries the 'Overview' title in regular-weight grotesk with an ink rule under it and a ghost Refresh button. Below it sit four outlined stat cards, an outlined chart card with pill time-range toggles, a recent-activity card of equal height, and a bordered projects table with pill filters and 2px arrow row actions. The only pink is the current-month bar, so the band and title clearly come first.

The header collapses to a pill nav strip with an ink-filled current pill and a search row. The teal band holds the title, a wrapped subtitle and a ghost Refresh. The stat cards reflow to a 2x2 grid, the chart and activity cards stack, and the table reflows into stacked row blocks with full-size arrow buttons. Nothing is cut off and nothing scrolls sideways.

The dark mapping holds: a black ground, raised dark cards with light hairline borders, a paper-filled current nav pill and the same teal band with ink text. The chart bars are dark outlined with the pink current bar, and the table, status pills and row-action buttons all stay legible.

The same stacked structure as the light mobile screen, on the dark ground. The paper current pill and the paper search button follow the dark inverse rule, the teal band keeps ink text, and the stacked project blocks keep readable labels and intact arrow buttons.

The section has its own periwinkle band with the 'Projects' h1 and an ink rule. Below it are an 'All projects' heading with a count, pill filters (the selected 'All' is outlined raised) and a filter input, then the bordered table with an ink rule under the header, underlined project links, outlined status pills and 2px arrow actions. It is dense and on the scale.

A periwinkle band with the title and one line of copy, then the heading and count, the pill filters and the filter field. The table reflows into stacked blocks, each with an underlined name, label/value rows, a status pill and an intact arrow button. Spacing is consistent and nothing overflows.

In dark, the periwinkle band keeps its ink title and the current 'Projects' pill turns paper-filled. The bordered table keeps its rows, status pills and arrow buttons readable on the black ground, matching the overview's dark mapping.

Stacked project blocks on dark raised cards, under the periwinkle band. The selected 'All' pill is outlined, the paper current nav pill follows the dark inverse rule, and every block's label, status pill and arrow button sit fully inside its border.

A breadcrumb sits above a periwinkle band that matches the parent section. The band holds the regular-weight project title, its meta line, a status pill at the right and pill tabs with a raised selected 'Overview'. Below is one outlined card with the description and a four-column meta row. It is sparse but follows the detail-page band recipe.

The breadcrumb and collapsed band stack the title, meta line, status pill and pill tabs at phone width. The summary card puts the description above a hairline rule, with the budget, due date, tasks and files stacked as label/value pairs. Clean and readable.

In dark, the band keeps its periwinkle with ink title and meta. The selected tab and the status pill are dark raised fills with light text, as the selected-pill rule allows, and the summary card is a dark raised box with a light border on black.
The mobile dark detail page keeps the periwinkle band with ink text, a dark selected 'Overview' pill and a dark status pill. The single summary card stacks its meta rows readably on the dark ground.

The Team section owns a yellow band with the title and a one-line summary. Below it is a bordered table with a subtle header row, initials avatars in outlined circles, underlined email links and right-aligned tabular counts. It is dense, aligned and has no art, as the data-table row asks.

The yellow band wraps its subtitle to two lines. The member table reflows into stacked blocks: an avatar, a name and an email link on top, then role, location and active projects as label/value rows. Consistent rhythm, nothing clipped.
The yellow band keeps its ink text in dark, the current 'Team' nav pill is paper, and the member table sits as a dark raised box with light hairlines, outlined avatars and readable email links.
Stacked member blocks on a dark raised card under the yellow band, with outlined initials avatars, underlined emails and right-aligned values. Every block is fully legible and inside its border.
